headword: {目玉商品|めだましょうひん}
gloss: featured item; headline product; loss leader

definitions.gloss: featured item; headline product; special attraction item
definitions.explanation: a product prominently featured in advertisements or sales to attract customers

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目玉商品|めだましょうひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧だ。
examples.english: Today's featured item is a half-price TV.

examples.japanese: {目玉商品|めだましょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{開店前|かいてんまえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: People line up before the store opens for the featured items.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目玉商品|めだましょうひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{集客|しゅうきゃく}{効果|こうか}→集客効果：29951_shuukyakukouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Supermarket featured items are highly effective at attracting customers.

notes:
{目玉商品|めだましょうひん} is a product featured prominently to attract customers.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{目玉|めだま}→目玉：13649_medama⟧ (eyeball, attention-grabber) + ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (product)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目玉商品|めだましょうひん}: today's featured item
- {目玉商品|めだましょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}す→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧: to promote a featured item

USAGE:
Common in retail advertising, especially supermarkets and department stores during sales events.
